home.title: Welcome
home.heading: Welcome to nuxvel
home.intro: A Nuxt app with the backend already built: a Postgres database, a typed API, sign-in, queues, mail and realtime. Put files in the right folders and nuxvel finds them.

steps.resource: Generate a resource with a table, API and pages

database.title: Database
database.text: Drizzle tables, migrations, seeders, pagination and full-text search.

api.title: Typed API
api.text: tRPC routers checked by Zod, available over REST with an OpenAPI document.

authorization.title: Auth & policies
authorization.text: Email and password sign-in, sessions, two-factor, and one policy per table.

queues.title: Queues & mail
queues.text: Background jobs, schedules and Vue mail templates, sent from the queue.

realtime.title: Realtime
realtime.text: Channels, presence and live queries over server-sent events.

testing.title: Testing
testing.text: Parallel tests against real Postgres, factories and browser tests.

verifyEmail.heading: Confirm your email address
verifyEmail.sentTo: A link to confirm your address went to {email}. Open it to finish signing up. The link expires in 24 hours.
verifyEmail.resent: A new link is on its way

offline.title: Offline
offline.heading: You are offline
offline.text: Check your connection, then reload the page.
